pages.name: Oyster and shiitake mushrooms (cultivated Pleurotus and Lentinula — cadmium accumulators)
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified standard for Oyster and shiitake mushrooms (cultivated Pleurotus and Lentinula — cadmium accumulators) (Edible Fungi), stated as sold. Each analyte carries the strictest applicable government maximum level in the product's native basis, with a disclosed read-across or a mandatory control where no government regulates the exact product.
